userStories.title: Project Scaffolding & Native Host Architecture
userStories.description: Initialize Twitch Drops Sentinel v3 workspace combining React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 + TypeScript with high-performance desktop host (WebView2 / C# .NET 10 / Python) ready for standalone exe compilation.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory structure created at C:/AI Local Projects/Ideas/Twitch Drops Sentinel v3
Frontend Vite + React 19 + Tailwind v4 builds with exit code 0
Desktop host initialized with dark title bar and custom 3D icon support
Clean IPC message channel setup between host and UI

userStories.title: Apple Liquid Glass UI / Frosted Obsidian Dashboard
userStories.description: Port and adapt the aesthetic from Luna (Apple Style Shutdown Utility v2): Bento Grid layout, frosted glass cards (backdrop-blur-xl), Lucide icons, tactile switches, glowing Twitch purple (#9146ff) & cyber cyan (#00f0ff) accents.
acceptanceCriteria: Top Sentinel HUD: Hardware Guard status, active game detector, battery status, network ping
Bento Card 1: Active drop circular progress tracker, ETA countdown, channel switcher
Bento Card 2: Stealth statistics (traffic saved in GB, GPU 0%, channel points earned)
Bento Card 3: Luna-style Auto-Shutdown timer toggle (turn off PC when farm completes)
Zero legacy Tkinter controls; 100% modern 60 FPS hardware-accelerated UI

userStories.title: Streamless Core Engine & Session Bridge
userStories.description: Connect reverse-engineered Smartbox GQL & WebSocket streamless engine with the UI via bidirectional IPC bridge, reusing active session cookies.jar.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth session loaded from existing cookies.jar without re-login prompt
Live campaign fetch and websocket drop progression hooked into React state
Auto-claim mechanism claiming drops and channel points in real time
Manual priority toggle and channel switching supported from the UI

userStories.title: Local PC 138 Games Scanner & 120+ Drop Catalog
userStories.description: Implement local game discovery scanner for Steam (76 games), E:/Games (12 games), and E:/Games Cracked (50 games) plus pre-seeded 120+ Twitch Drops game catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-detects 138 installed games across Steam, E:/Games, and E:/Games Cracked
Displays 'Установлено на ПК 💾' badge on all installed titles
Instant real-time search filter and one-click add to Priority or Exclude lists
Pre-seeded catalog covers all major categories (FPS, ARPG, MMO, Gacha, Survival)

userStories.title: Hardware Guard Sensors & Luna Auto-Shutdown
userStories.description: Background watcher monitoring running processes via psutil to automatically pause streamless farming during gaming or battery usage, plus auto-shutdown when finished.
acceptanceCriteria: Instant pause upon detecting any of user's 138 installed games (PoE 2, Hunt, Hearthstone, GoW, RDR2, etc.)
Auto-pause on battery power when unplugged
Smooth resume with grace countdown after exiting game
Luna-style Auto-Shutdown option: powers off or sleeps PC when all priority drops are claimed

userStories.title: Trophy Vault Card Gallery & Native Toast Notifications
userStories.description: Visual loot museum displaying all claimed drops with card previews, campaign names, claim timestamps, and native Windows 10/11 Toasts.
acceptanceCriteria: Every claimed item saved into local storage / SQLite / Trophies.md
Interactive visual cards with 3D hover effects in the Trophy Vault tab
Native Windows Toast fired on every claimed reward via WinRT
Export history to Markdown/CSV

userStories.title: Standalone Monolithic EXE Compilation Pipeline
userStories.description: Configure single-file executable packaging creating TwitchDropsSentinel.exe with embedded cyber shield 3D icon and zero external runtime requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Build script compiles TwitchDropsSentinel.exe cleanly
Executable runs without command prompt flash and nests in system tray
Custom 3D shield icon visible on taskbar, window title, and tray
Verified launch and verified exit code 0
